operating_notes.text: Single segment: printing inks, per note 3 of the results.
Q3FY26 carried a ₹236.45 lakh exceptional provision for past gratuity cost under the new labour codes; no such charge in Q4FY26.
Rated bank facilities total ₹100 Cr — HDFC Bank ₹10 Cr cash credit and ₹30 Cr LC/BG; Standard Chartered ₹25 Cr cash credit and ₹35 Cr LC/BG.
Received final order from Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax reducing transfer pricing adjustment to ₹3.74 Cr for AY 2023-24.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹240.52 Cr (+14.4% YoY), net profit ₹4.24 Cr (+63.7% YoY).
2026-06-02: MD & CEO Manish Bhatia resigned, accepted by the board; he is to be relieved at close of business on 29 August 2026.
2026-10-15: CRISIL reaffirmed DIC India's long-term rating at CRISIL A/Stable and short-term at CRISIL A1 on ₹100 Cr bank facilities, plus CRISIL A1 on ₹50 Cr short-term debt.
DIC India received a final income tax order reducing the transfer pricing adjustment for AY 2023-24 to ₹3.74 Cr.

upcoming_events.description: Manish Bhatia relieved as Managing Director and CEO at close of business
